column1: # DoD #1 — one source of truth per computed fact (plan v6 §2 / v7 §3.8, row 1).
# "No two functions compute residency, placement, timestomp tier, name->record resolution, an extent map
# for the same holder form, or checkpoint parsing." This file NAMES each fact and its single function;
# `check_single_source.py` fails if a second implementation appears.
# A fact is listed with the ONE function that computes it. `refsanalysis.py` may IMPORT from forefst.py --
# that is what makes it one source -- but it may not define its own version. The lint checks definitions,
# not calls, because a call is reuse and a definition is a fork.
# Extent maps are the exception the plan already anticipates: there are two HOLDER FORMS, so there are two
# readings plus one heuristic fallback, and the entry below names all three deliberately (v7.4 §3.2). One
# source per FORM, not one source overall.
